title: RUMI: A Robotiq-Matched Universal Manipulation Interface for Robot Learning with Augmented Reality and Haptic Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.15802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many manipulation tasks require carefully controlled contact forces for successful execution, yet large-scale, force-aware datasets remain scarce. Handheld interfaces can help by transmitting interaction forces directly through the operator's arm, but most existing designs are tailored to simple linear grippers and do not match the nonlinear mechanics of widely used robotic grippers. We present RUMI, a handheld universal manipulation interface matched to the Robotiq 2F-85 with exchangeable fingertip sensors that preserves the target gripper geometry while enabling natural input before contact and force measurement after contact. By integrating the tracking system into a virtual reality headset, our method provides real-time augmented reality feedback about the kinematic feasibility of motion on the target robot platform. translated_title: RUMI：一种与Robotiq匹配的通用操作接口，用于结合增强现实与触觉反馈的机器人学习
translated_abstract: 许多操作任务需要精确控制的接触力才能成功执行，然而大规模的力觉感知数据集仍然稀缺。手持式接口可以通过将交互力直接传递到操作者的手臂来提供帮助，但现有设计大多针对简单的线性夹爪，无法匹配广泛使用的机器人夹爪的非线性力学特性。我们提出了RUMI，这是一种与Robotiq 2F-85相匹配的手持式通用操作接口，配备可更换的指尖传感器，在保持目标夹爪几何结构的同时，实现了接触前的自然输入和接触后的力测量。通过将跟踪系统集成到虚拟现实头显中，我们的方法能够提供关于目标机器人平台上运动学可行性的实时增强现实反馈。我们进一步引入了一种触觉反馈机制，支持对模拟和真实机器人进行力觉感知的遥操作。
tldr: RUMI是一种与Robotiq 2F-85夹爪相匹配的手持式通用操作接口，通过可更换指尖传感器、增强现实实时反馈和触觉反馈机制，实现了力觉感知的遥操作，为机器人学习提供了大规模力觉数据采集的新方案。
en_tdlr: RUMI is a handheld universal manipulation interface matched to the Robotiq 2F-85 gripper that combines exchangeable fingertip sensors, real-time augmented reality feedback, and haptic feedback to enable force-aware teleoperation and large-scale force-aware data collection for robot learning.
